translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: «Israa'eeliyaa asaa booray woy dorssay bayiide wora biishshiina be'ooppe, sheneko gaade agga aggoppa; Aa godaw laagga ahaade imma.
He mehiyaa goday ne heera gidana d'ayooppe, woy Aa goday oonentto neeni erana d'ayooppe, Aa goday koyiidde yaana gakkanaw, ne golle akkaade afa; I yiide, demmiyaa wode, aw imma.
Hewaadan hariyaa gidina, mayuwaa woy ayaanne bayeeddawaa demmooppe, Aa godaw zaarappe attina, sheneko gooppa.
«Israa'eeliyaa asaa harii woy booray ogiyaan kunddeeddawaa be'ooppe, maaddaade dentsappe attina, sheneko gaade agga aggoppa.
«Mac'c'a Asay attuma asaa mayuwaa mayyoppino; attuma asaykka mac'c'a asaa mayuwaa mayyoppino. Ayaw gooppe, hewaa malabaa ootsiyaa oonanne Med'inaa Goday hintte S'oossay shaattee.
«Ogiyaan ne biishshiina, mitsan gidina, sa'aan bare maraa woy k'uuk'k'ulliyaa hap'p'a utteedda kafatto demmooppe, izo I maraanna gatsa oyk'k'aade ne golle afoppa.
Maratuwaa akka afanaw danddayaasa; shin daayo baanaadan yedda agga. Hewaadan ootsooppe, neeni durettaade adussa laytsaa de'ana.
«Ooratsa golliyaa kees's'iyaa wode, d'ok'k'a kaaraappe Asay kunddi hayk'k'ina ne ooshettennaadan, zemppiide attiyaawaa giigissa.
«Ne woyniyaa shoyk'aan laa"u k'ommo katsaa zeroppa; hewaadan ootsooppe, ne zereedda katsaynne woynnii laa"uukka bayana.
«Booraanne hariyaa ittippe waas'aade goshoppa.
«Suufiyaappenne liinuwaappe walakan dadetteedda mayuwaa mayyoppa.
«Ne mayyeedda mayoo oyddu bagganakka mac'aray de'o.
Geluwaa Akuwaa Geeshshatetsaan Naagiyaawaa
«Itti Asay machchato akkiide, izina ak'i simmiide, izo dosana d'ayooppe,
‹Hanno ta akkaade izina ak'iyaa wode, higgii iziw baawa› yaagiide izo bayzziide haasayooppe,
he naatti aawunne daaya I higgiyaa malaataa akki afiide, katamaa penggiyaan de'iyaa c'imatuwaa bessino.
Naatti aawuu c'imatoo hawaadan yaagiide odo, ‹Taani ta naatto hawoo machche ootsaade immaad; shin I izo is's'eedda.
I, «Ne naattin higgii baawa» yaagiide izo bayzziide haasaye; shin ta naatti higgiyaa malaataa hawaa be'ite› yaagiide, izi higgiyaa erissiyaa c'ark'k'iyaa besso.
Yaatina he katamaa c'imatuu Aa murino.

I Israa'eeliyaa wodoratti suntsaa bayzzeedda diraw, c'imatuu Aa s'eetu s'agaraa biraa muriide, hewaa naatti aawoo immino. Naattakka aw machche gidaade de'u; bare de'o laytsaa ubbaan I izo yeddanaw bessena.
«Aa mootuu tuma gidiide, naattin wodorotetsay d'ayooppe,

naatto izi aawuwaa kare ahiide, he katamaa attuma Asay izo shuchchaan c'addiide wod'o. Ayaw gooppe, Aa bare aawuwaa son de'aadde sharmus'a gidaade, Israa'eeliyaa giddon ha pokkobaa ootsaaddu; hewaadan ootsiide hintte giddoppe iitaa diggite.
«Ay asaynne hara asaa mac'c'a asaana sharmus'iidde oyk'k'etooppe, ikka aanana sharmus'eedda mac'c'a mishiratakka hayk'k'ino. Hewaadan ootsiide, hintte giddoppe iitaa diggite.
«Ay asaynne haraw giigeedda wodoratto katamaa giddon demmiide izina sharmus'ooppe,

unttuntta laa"uwaakka katamaappe gas'aa kessiide, shuchchaan c'addiide wod'ite. Ayaw gooppe, naatta kataman de'aadde, Asay ashshanaadan waassabeykku. I hayk'k'iyaawe k'ay hara asaw giiga utteedda wodoratto bayzzeedda gishshaassa. Hewaadan ootsiyaawaan hintte giddoppe iitaa diggite.
«Itti Asay asaw giigeedda wodoratto Asay bayinna sa'aan wolk'k'an oyk'k'iide, izina gisooppe, Aa s'alalay hayk'k'o.
Naatto ayinne ootsoppite; izo wod'anaw bessiyaa nagaraa ootsabeykku. Hawe itti Asay c'oo bare shooruwaa bolla denddiide, wod'iyaa asaa pirddaa mala pirddaa.
Ayaw gooppe, I izo Asay bayinna sa'aan demmiide oyk'k'ina, he wodoro naatta waassaaddu; shin izo ashshiyaa Asay de'ibeenna.
«Ay asaynne asaw giigabeenna wodoratto oyk'k'iide, I higgiyaa akki diggiide oyk'k'etooppe,
naatti aawoo ishatamu s'agaraa biraa c'iggo. Yaatiide naatto barew machche ootso. Bare de'o laytsaa ubbaan izo yeddoppo.
«Ay asaynne bare aawuwaa machchato akkiide, bare aawuwaa kawushshoppo.
